'''Darth Vader's Security Force''' were the elite personal [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] that were visually identical to [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] and the [[Vader's Special Force Trooper]], only having [[Color/Legends|red]]-colored armor instead of the usual white armor. The Security Force, alongside the Special Force Troopers, were led by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader during the [[Occupation of Bespin]]. Their equipment also included shields, grenades, and [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]], the former being similar in nature to those used by the [[Stormtrooper grenadier/Legends|grenadier troopers]].
